question: Train A leaves station M at 7:55 a.m. and reaches station N at 2:55 p.m. on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 9:55 a.m. and reaches station M at 2:55 p.m. on the same day. Find the time when Trains A and B meet.
solution:
**Given:**

Train A departs at 7:55 a.m. and reaches at 2:55 p.m.

Train B departs at 9:55 a.m. and reaches at 2:55 p.m.

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed = Speed of Train A + Speed of Train B (when moving towards each other)

Time = Distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total travel time of Train A = 2:55 p.m. - 7:55 a.m. = 7 hours

⇒ Total travel time of Train B = 2:55 p.m. - 9:55 a.m. = 5 hours

⇒ D
